claim_boundary: This freeze occurred before the new blind runner was executed.
The score is an exact rank lower bound for the discovered quotient, not a Mordell-Weil rank upper bound.
The public displayed jump is a certified displayed-subgroup quotient, not an assertion of full E(Q).
The sixteen cases are a fixed atlas-refresh panel rather than a random population sample.

descriptive_only: recovery fractions relative to displayed jumps
timeouts and PARI failures under the equal maximum budget

joint_decision.stop_rule: if either endpoint fails, do not spend serious rank-32 point-search budget on the half-lattice extreme-jump hypothesis

ordinal_endpoint.null: truth labels are exchangeable across the sixteen fixed cases
ordinal_endpoint.p_value: exact one-sided permutation probability of concordance-minus-discordance at least as large as observed, preserving all ties
ordinal_endpoint.statistic: Kendall tau-b between blind score and displayed jump

confirmatory_analysis.truth: exact displayed-subgroup free quotient rank by specialized MW17

upper_tail_endpoint.acceptance: risk difference >= 0.25 and one-sided Fisher exact p <= 0.05
upper_tail_endpoint.statistic: detector-positive risk difference, tail minus non-tail, with one-sided Fisher exact p

forbidden_until_blind_artifact_is_frozen: every public point P18 or beyond
displayed quotient rank or jump label
coordinates of blind discoveries in the displayed public basis

objective: Test whether exact quotient rank recovered by one fixed adaptive half-lattice policy is ordinally associated with exact displayed jump and enriches the predeclared +10/+11/+12 tail.

pre_search_exclusion.reason: displayed quotient by specialized MW17 is not defined because MW17 is not contained in the displayed subgroup

search_policy.adaptive_pool: the first 301 generic parity masks by decreasing exact generic depth then mask, paired cyclically with nonzero quotient words ordered by Hamming weight then integer value
search_policy.adaptive_representative_and_order: recompute the current canonical-height form, generic coordinates, deterministic mod-2 quotient complement, every selected shortest representative, and the complete 301-chart order for that exact state; order by decreasing exact-decimal depth then mask and word
search_policy.adaptive_trigger: at least one exactly certified initial quotient direction
search_policy.initial_representative_and_order: shortest representatives at rounded specialized canonical-height scale 10^6; decreasing exact-decimal depth, then mask
search_policy.initial_universe: all 43 maximum-norm parity classes in the complete exact generic MW17 half-lattice census
search_policy.state_binding: bind both orders to the full basis, height Gram, generic-coordinate rows, quotient-complement rows, universe id, and ordered chart ids
search_policy.structural_zero_rule: if the initial exact recovered quotient rank is zero, the adaptive quotient space is empty and the fixed policy stops after 43 charts
